options.description: Global options controlling output and behavior

options.print.description: Print contents of block or inode

options.ls.description: Print directories, one line per entry

options.accept.description: List of accepted filenames (can be empty)

options.show_path_inodes.description: Show inode of each directory component in paths

filters.after.description: Only process entries deleted on or after this dtime

filters.before.description: Only process entries deleted before this dtime

filters.reallocated.description: Do not suppress entries with reallocated inodes

filters.zeroed_inodes.description: Do not suppress entries with zeroed inodes

filters.depth.description: Recursive depth limit for directory processing

actions.inode_to_block.description: Inode number to convert to block

actions.inode.description: Inode number to show info for

actions.block.description: Block number to show info for

actions.journal_block.description: Journal block number to show info for

actions.journal_transaction.description: Transaction sequence number to show info for

actions.dump_names.description: Write paths of files to stdout (implies --ls)

actions.search_start.description: Fixed string to search at block start

actions.search.description: Fixed string to search within blocks

actions.search_inode.description: Block number to find inodes that refer to it

actions.search_zeroed_inodes.description: Return allocated inode table entries that are zeroed

actions.inode_dirblock_table.description: Directory path for which to print directory block table

actions.show_journal_inodes.description: Inode number to show copies still in the journal

actions.restore_file.description: Path of file to restore (relative to root, no leading slash)

actions.show_hardlinks.description: Show all inodes shared by two or more files

paths.description: Target filesystem images or device files to analyze
